name: Prestigious Spellcaster (Mythic)
body:
Your magic abilities grow much more quickly when you take levels in a prestige class.

Prerequisite(s): Prestigious Spellcaster.

Benefit(s): Your favored prestige class is considered to grant an increase in effective level for the purpose of casting spells at every level. This effect is retroactive if you gain this feat at a level beyond the point where your favored prestige class would normally have not advanced your spellcasting.

If your favored prestige class does not have the spells per day class feature, it is considered to grant a level increase at every odd level. This feat still does not work if the prestige class already grants a level increase at every level (like arcane trickster or loremaster), and the total increase to your effective caster level still cannot exceed your actual prestige class level.
